title: ServiceCommandRequest
description: Command the UI sends to the service's local message port `ambilight.status`, with `ambilight.ui` as the reply port. A bundle of string key/values. The service replies with ServiceCommandReply.

ServiceCommand.title: ServiceCommand
ServiceCommand.description: Commands without arguments. `pause`: stop capture (state `paused`) until `resume`. `resume`: restart capture after `pause`. `rediscover`: probe for controllers now.

ServiceSetOutputsRequest.title: ServiceSetOutputsRequest
ServiceSetOutputsRequest.description: `set-outputs`: turn the ESP32 and HyperHDR outputs on or off and set the HyperHDR target, live, and save that for the next start.

commandId.description: Optional request id, chosen by the UI; the service echoes it as `id` in the reply, so a late reply can't be taken for the answer to another command. Without it the reply has no `id` (older UIs). A longer id is answered with ok: false and no `id`, without running the command.
